## What's new

- **Find in page.** Press Command+F in any Ficus window to search the text on screen, with Command+G and Shift+Command+G to move between matches. Find is also in the Edit menu.
- **Search a chat's full history.** A search panel in agent chats finds messages across the whole conversation, not just what's loaded, and jumps straight to any result.
- **See when teammates are typing.** When several people have the same agent chat open, a typing bubble with the teammate's name appears above the composer while they write.
- **Diagrams in Markdown.** Mermaid diagrams in chat messages, work stream descriptions, briefs and plans now render as diagrams, with a toggle to view the source.
- **A steadier working indicator.** The indicator stays up after you send a message until the agent's new run starts, and no longer drops when the connection replays the previous turn.
- **Agents can ask before restarting your services.** Agents can now ask for your approval to restart a service they manage, instead of the request being refused.
- **Faster, more reliable new hosts.** Setting up a new Ficus Cloud host takes fewer package-install passes, retries slow package sources, and reports its progress through each setup phase.
- **Smaller fixes.** Agent reply timestamps line up with their messages, squad active-agent counts include consultants, and running monitors count as agent activity.
